summary.zh: 地址解析、路线规划与周边搜索

description.zh: 提供地址与坐标互转、驾车步行路线规划、周边地点搜索与天气查询。适合出行规划或按位置找店。填好地址即可连接。
description.en: Convert between addresses and coordinates, plan driving and walking routes, search nearby places, and check weather. Useful for trip planning or finding shops by location. Connect with the URL alone.

authHint.zh: 无需授权，填好地址即可连接
authHint.en: No sign-in needed, connect with the URL
